items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It was just those snare drums going. And there was a Brazilian exchange student in the class and he perked up immediately and I said oh this is real then. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.
